# Research Background — Linux-PERFORMANCE

## 🎯 Scientific Motivation
Linux-PERFORMANCE was created to provide a reproducible, modular and transparent
framework for system optimization, security hardening and engineering-grade
automation on Linux Mint.

The project aims to support:
- reproducible experiments
- performance benchmarking
- system engineering research
- reproducible computational environments

## 🧪 Research Context
Modern scientific workflows require:
- stable and reproducible environments
- transparent system configurations
- controlled performance baselines
- automated setup pipelines

Linux-PERFORMANCE addresses these needs by providing:
- deterministic scripts
- modular architecture
- documented system changes
- reproducible execution paths

## 📚 Scientific Relevance
This project can be used in:
- systems engineering research
- reproducible computing studies
- performance analysis
- cybersecurity hardening research
- automation and DevOps education

## 🔬 Methodology
The project follows:
- modular decomposition
- deterministic execution
- minimal side effects
- transparent configuration
- scientific documentation standards
